title: Chapter 135 Confusion
content:
Chapter 135 Confusion

Hearing the sound of horseshoes on the cliffs on both sides, the expressions of the six people who were confronting each other changed.

Who actually came here at this time? Could it be that we are caught by the mantis and the oriole is behind? Thinking of this, the faces of the six people became ugly. Obviously, they didn't like this result very much.

Damn it, I've already inquired about it before, and there's no one around, so what's going on with this group of people who popped up out of nowhere?

"Eldest Young Master Commander, what's the matter? Before the ambush, you were not asked to go to the surrounding area for dozens of miles to investigate. How could someone come?" Yun Zhongjun, the head of the five elders, asked the elder and young master Ming asked.

"Mr. Yunzhong, the two of us have already looked at it before, and we didn't find anyone. They should have just arrived, and they must have just been attracted by the sound of our fighting," said the older Da Si Ming.

"The ones who just came, who the hell are they? There are hundreds of knights, and they all look like masters in the world. How many of them even feel a threat to me!" Yun Zhongjun said with a smile on his face. Revealed dignified color.

Hearing Yun Zhongjun's words, the other four elders nodded in agreement. The same gaze stared at the knights on the cliffs on both sides above his head.

The six-fingered black man on the side also looked nervously at the knights on the cliff, and saw them all stretching their bows and arrows, pointing at their bodies with sharp arrows shining coldly.

"Who is this person?"

Everyone present thought of this sentence in their hearts.

Pa... Pa... Pa, there was a burst of rhythmic applause, but a man in a purple brocade robe came up from the left side of the cliff, and all the knights around him stepped aside and bowed in salute.

"It's an eye-opener, it's really an eye-opener, the competition you just had, really made me see it!" Zhong Yu looked at the guarded looks of those people below, and didn't take it seriously, but laughed loudly.

Several people looked at each other, and found that they didn't know that person, and then Yun Zhongjun and Six Fingers Heixia stared at each other, but found that neither of them knew the man in brocade clothes above.

"Who is your Excellency? What is your purpose here at this moment?" Looking around, he found that he was alone. The so-called barefoot is not afraid of wearing shoes. Six Fingers Heixia said to Zhong Yu bluntly.

"It doesn't matter who I am, the important thing is that when I was passing by this road with a few of my servants, I saw you fighting here, which greatly increased my interest." First, I explained why When I came to this place, "But I haven't finished watching it, and you guys stopped it. It's really disappointing. What should I do? Tell me!"

The faces of the six people in the canyon darkened when they heard Zhong Yu's teasing words above.

"Your Excellency, are you playing us like monkeys? Although you have a lot of people and are recharging your energy, if you really fight, even if you can't kill you, you will have to knock out some of your teeth!" The grumpy six-fingered black man , said angrily.

"Being a monkey, no, no, you know, you are all fourth-order powerhouses. Oh, yes, it seems that you don't understand the strength of the world. In other words, you are all of this world." First-class powerhouses, how dare I treat you like monkeys?" Frivolous explanations popped out of Zhong Yu's mouth.

"Then gossip, what is the purpose of your coming here? If you are passing by, please go, I will get out of the way. If you are looking for trouble, then show your weapon, we will see the truth under your hands !" Suppressing the anger in his heart so as not to explode, Six Fingers Heixia said in a strong tone.

"Purpose? Didn't I just say it? Watching you guys fight made me addicted, but you suddenly stopped and made me feel so uncomfortable!" Zhong Yu said softly, Halfway through, he stopped. Gently squeezed his throat, it seemed that it was a bit strenuous to talk for so long.

"Since I didn't enjoy myself to the fullest, how can you masters of the show leave the stage so quickly? I'd rather let these worthless servants of mine come and help and add to the fun!" Zhong Yu's tone became more and more strange , When it comes to the end, the taste has completely changed.

Behind Zhong Yu, following his words, the accompanying generals, Zhao Yun, Zhang Fei, Xu Chu, and Dian Wei are four martial arts talents who have reached the fourth level. With a clang, they pulled out the sabers worn around their waists one after another.

Accompanied by the leaders of the two hidden guards, one hand was turned backwards, and a gesture was made, which also signaled the many dark guards under their command to prepare for battle. The two chiefs signaled to nearly two hundred hidden guards, who held their special weapons slightly with both hands, staring intently at them, but there were only six people below.

For a moment, swords were on the verge of breaking out in this small area of a few miles, and the aura of coldness and murder permeated the air.

"Let's go! It seems that you and I, a fight is inevitable. The sons and daughters of the rivers and lakes live under the shadow of swords and swords, and it is common sense to die. It's just that I don't understand. It seems that you and I have never met. But listen to you How could you rather kill me at the risk of harming your own subordinates, as if there had never been any conflicts and fights?" Six Fingers Heixia had been holding back this question since Zhong Yu first appeared. In my heart, I finally took this opportunity to speak out at this moment.

"You are very curious, wondering why I want to kill you?" Zhong Yu said with a light smile.

"That's right!" Six Fingers Heixia shouted loudly.

"The five of us are also very curious. They are neither relatives nor relatives, neither kind nor enmity, two groups of people who have never met before. Why do you insist on putting me to death? Do you have any grievances with us and the Yin Yang family? "Watching from the sidelines all the time, the conversation between Zhong Yu and the six black heroes has been silent all the time, Yun Zhongjun said in a calm voice at this moment.

"That's right, you and I don't have any grievances at all, and we have never met each other. Just like this, it's nothing more than ordinary people with no strength. It's like crushing a few ants. No one cares at all. .But it would be unreasonable for those of you who have status and high strength. Not to mention the loss of strength for no reason, you have also provoked a bunch of enemies! Anyone who sees it is a loss-making business." Follow these few people Zhong Yu slowly expressed their doubts in their hearts.

"However, we have no enmity, but no one stipulates that there must be enmity between two people in a life-and-death struggle. Interests, as well as differences in the camps of the two sides, can also cause a bloody storm." Among the six people Under his expectant eyes, Zhong Yu revealed his motive for doing so.

"Benefits and camps are different. It seems that we are in two groups with fundamentally opposing forces. The contradictions between each other are irreconcilable. It's either you die or I live. So, I'm curious, which snobbery are you? Qin, but you seem to think that even the members of the Yinyang family will be killed together. The Yinyang family is the loyal lackey of Qin. And the other six countries are now fighting against Qin together, so how could they come to harm me? Where is this Mohist giant who insists on resisting Qin? Could it be that you are some other unknown force?" After a while of analysis, the more the six-fingered black man analyzed, the more he couldn't figure out which force these people in front of him belonged to?
